headline: Is It Time to Replace My Drafty Doors?
articleBody: If you're constantly feeling a chill near your doorways or hear outside noise a little too clearly, it might be time to think about door replacement. Drafty doors aren't just uncomfortable; they're also a major contributor to higher energy bills, letting your conditioned air escape. Beyond drafts, look for visible signs of wear like cracked or peeling paint, rot, or rust, especially on exterior doors. Is your door hard to open or close, sticking in its frame? That could indicate structural issues or simply that the door has warped over time. A door that doesn't seal properly can also be a security risk. Replacing an old, inefficient door with a modern, well-insulated one can drastically improve your home's energy efficiency, comfort, and curb appeal. For homeowners in areas like Pasadena or Lake Forest, upgrading doors can make a real difference in both aesthetics and functionality. If you're noticing any of these issues, it's definitely worth having a professional take a look. Affordable Home Remodeling can assess your doors and suggest the best replacement options.
